subject: Mathematics
title: Differentiation
summary: Derivative f′(x) = lim (h→0) (f(x + h) − f(x))/h instantaneous rate of change aur tangent ka slope naapta hai.

Standard derivatives aur rules seekho: sum, product, quotient aur chain rule. Khaas techniques: implicit, logarithmic, parametric differentiation, aur substitution se inverse trigonometric functions ke derivatives.
Higher-order derivatives (second derivative) aur ek function ka doosre ke respect mein derivative chapter poora karte hain.

formulas.name: Power, exponential, log
formulas.formula: d(xⁿ)/dx = nxⁿ⁻¹;  d(eˣ)/dx = eˣ;  d(aˣ)/dx = aˣ ln a;  d(ln x)/dx = 1/x;  d(logₐx)/dx = 1/(x ln a)

formulas.name: Trigonometric
formulas.formula: (sin x)′ = cos x;  (cos x)′ = −sin x;  (tan x)′ = sec²x;  (cot x)′ = −cosec²x;  (sec x)′ = sec x tan x;  (cosec x)′ = −cosec x cot x

formulas.name: Chain rule
formulas.mistake: Bahar wala differentiate karo, andar wala waisa hi rakho, phir andar wale ke derivative se multiply karo — ye step mat bhoolna.

formulas.name: Implicit differentiation
formulas.formula: differentiate both sides w.r.t. x, treating y as a function of x;  then solve for dy/dx
formulas.when: Jo equations y ke liye solve nahi hain.

formulas.name: Logarithmic differentiation
formulas.formula: y = u^v ⇒ ln y = v ln u ⇒ y′/y = v′ ln u + v u′/u

formulas.name: Parametric differentiation
formulas.when: x(t), y(t) se di gayi curves.
formulas.mistake: d²y/dx², (d²y/dt²)/(d²x/dt²) nahi hota — galat formula mat lagaana.

formulas.name: Derivative of one function w.r.t. another
formulas.when: f ko g ke respect mein differentiate karna.

formulas.name: Substitution for inverse trig
formulas.formula: √(1 − x²) → x = sin θ;  (1 − x²)/(1 + x²) → x = tan θ;  2x/(1 − x²) → x = tan θ
formulas.when: Differentiate karne se pehle simplify karo.

examples.title: Logarithmic differentiation
examples.solution: ln y = x ln x ⇒ y′/y = ln x + 1 ⇒ y′ = xˣ(1 + ln x).

examples.title: Parametric
examples.problem: x = t², y = 2t. t = 2 par dy/dx nikalo.

examples.title: Second derivative
examples.problem: y = x³. x = 2 par y″ nikalo.

examples.title: Inverse-trig substitution
examples.problem: |x| < 1 ke liye d/dx tan⁻¹(2x/(1 − x²)), x = 0 par?
examples.solution: x = tan θ lene par function 2θ = 2tan⁻¹x hai, isliye derivative 2/(1 + x²) = x = 0 par 2.

topics.title: Derivative as rate
topics.explain: Agar s(t) position hai to s′(t) velocity aur s″(t) acceleration. Kisi point par dy/dx wahan tangent ka slope hai.

topics.title: Derivatives of modulus and greatest integer
topics.explain: d|x|/dx = x/|x| (x ≠ 0). [x] ka derivative integers ke beech 0 hai aur integers par differentiable nahi.

topics.title: Derivative of determinants
topics.explain: Ek baar mein ek row differentiate karo aur bane determinants jodo.

topics.title: Rolle's and mean value theorems
topics.explain: Rolle's: f, [a, b] par continuous, (a, b) par differentiable, f(a) = f(b) ⇒ kisi c ke liye f′(c) = 0. LMVT: f′(c) = (f(b) − f(a))/(b − a).

topics.title: Even/odd and derivatives
topics.explain: Even function ka derivative odd aur odd function ka derivative even hota hai. Periodic functions ke derivatives same period ke saath periodic hote hain.

topics.title: Leibniz rule for nth derivatives
topics.explain: (uv)⁽ⁿ⁾ = Σ C(n, r) u⁽ⁿ⁻ʳ⁾ v⁽ʳ⁾. xⁿeˣ jaise products ke liye kaam ka.

ratta: (tan x)′ = sec²x;  (sec x)′ = sec x tan x.
